title: CrewAI
summary: CrewAI is a framework for building, orchestrating, and managing autonomous AI agent teams. It empowers developers to define collaborative agents, assign them tasks, and integrate diverse tools and knowledge sources to solve complex problems. The framework provides robust capabilities for workflow automation, LLM integration, state management, and seamless deployment of intelligent systems.

nodes.label: Developer / AI Engineer
nodes.title: Human User
nodes.description: Designs, builds, runs, and manages AI agent systems using CrewAI, interacting with the framework and its tools.

nodes.label: Core Agent Framework
nodes.title: CrewAI Core Framework
nodes.description: Defines the foundational architecture for creating, orchestrating, and managing intelligent agents and their collaborative workflows, including tasks and state management.

nodes.label: Agent Tools & RAG
nodes.title: Agent Tools & Knowledge
nodes.description: Provides agents with diverse external tools and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) capabilities for accessing, processing, and utilizing information from various sources.

nodes.label: CLI & Dev Tools
nodes.title: CLI & Developer Utilities
nodes.description: Offers command-line interfaces and developer tools for project scaffolding, running, testing, deploying, and managing CrewAI projects throughout their lifecycle.

nodes.label: Agent-to-Agent Communication
nodes.title: Inter-Agent Collaboration
nodes.description: Enables secure and structured delegation of tasks and information exchange between different AI agents, facilitating complex collaborative workflows.

nodes.label: External LLM Providers
nodes.title: Large Language Models
nodes.description: Third-party AI models (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) that power agent reasoning, generation, and understanding capabilities within CrewAI.

nodes.label: External Data Sources
